The numbered public lesson order stays stable while example support, loaders, links, and proof ownership use final forms.

Requirements and decisions
R2, R4, R8, R10-R13, R16; KTD1-KTD3, KTD6, KTD8, KTD9.

Affected surfaces
test/examples/**; examples/**; shared example support; test/examples/catalog.yml; test/quality/component_proof.yml; and current README links.

Implementation direction
Keep numbered lesson and catalog structure. Rename executable modules and shared fixtures. Update loaders and common runtime support. Preserve :example and :peer on peer cases. Keep repetition when standalone teaching needs it. Register examples as the canonical owner of executable documentation claims. Link repeated runtime assertions to the canonical behavior claim as supplemental evidence.

Acceptance
The catalog resolves every lesson and current link. Examples stay out of default and run through test.examples. Peer cases retain both roles. Standalone lessons use current support. Each example owns its documentation claim and links repeated runtime proof to the canonical component claim.

Verification
mix test.examples --warnings-as-errors
mix test.peer --warnings-as-errors
mix test test/examples/catalog_test.exs test/quality/component_proof_test.exs --seed 0
mix format --check-formatted

Completion signal
The catalog and peer cases pass, example proof ownership is complete, and U7 can start.
